sources.rule: Understand D1, the level and direction first; entry then locates a technical stop and reward/risk.
H1 checks direction, level behavior and accumulation before finer entry timing.
Compression describes lows/closes progressing toward a level, not merely a triangle name.
A close retest alone does not justify a breakout against the broader directional context.
The confirmation-entry example waits for pressure to break and a full bar beyond the level, with a structural stop.
Wait for the penetration and return; the extreme provides a technical stop reference.
For LP place the stop beyond its wick; 10% ATR is a reference, not a mandatory stop distance.
A technical stop is structural; position size depends on specified money risk divided by stop distance.
The worked example computes 3R from entry and stop; it is not an observed target label for another chart.
A channel entry needs room to its next boundary; the example requires 4 stops to preserve about 3R after execution.
Distinguish a close beyond then return from repeated ineffective crossings and wick contacts.
Use density, reaction, anchor quality, confluence, progressive body strength and 1.5% spacing.
Paranormal requires real body >=1.6 prior ATR, not total high-low and not the historical 2.5 threshold.
Gap, consolidation and false-breakout origins are not working level types; LP is entry context only.
A repeated same-side wick return on adjacent bars is chop. LP1/LP2 do not vote for level price/strength.
The continuous body score is 2.5*r/(r+1.5), separately from the >=1.6 paranormal classification.
A wick sweeping an earlier level does not become a new origin merely by being a further extreme.

level_confluence: One price is one level; independent allowed types strengthen it without duplicating the line.

false_breakouts.one_bar: Open and close on the original side; wick penetrates beyond the permitted micro-luft.
false_breakouts.two_bar: First bar closes beyond the level, next bar returns and closes on the original side.
false_breakouts.chop: Adjacent repeated same-side wick-return bars are chop, not multiple LP1 entries.

training_target: Rank the user-annotated H1 entry state above earlier unselected states of the same scenario.
direction_role: Known D1/H1 scenario context supplied to the entry model; not the prediction target.
daily_close_rule_source: Latest user clarification: a daily false breakout is not confirmed until the D1 bar closes; all TVH candidates must wait for D1 close.
comparison_label_meaning: Earlier unselected states are not labelled losing trades and do not prove a later entry was profitable.
unknown_numeric_target_policy: Keep null; do not derive targets from profitable outcome pixels or assume fixed ATR multiples.
feature_cutoff: Only observations available before the annotated decision; result descriptions and future chart pixels are forbidden live predictive features.
split_policy: Keep both timeframes, repeated dates/instruments and duplicate scenarios together; chronological validation needs verified dates.
